comment: Independent source-first Prep28 v64 setup: {"id":"v64-longworm-no-move-setup1","source":{"file":"monmove.c","function":"m_move"},"state":"Long worm with initialized tail in confined terrain and no legal move while able to move","expectedCObservation":"worm_nomove shrinks the tail on failed movement; cannot substitute sleeping/frozen early returns","overlapHypothesis":"Must establish actual source MMOVE_NOTHING and tail change from C."}. Source hypotheses are not runtime evidence. Actual branch reachability and independence will be checked from the new C recording. New C-source refinement {"id":"v64-peaceful-worm-kicked-exit-scout3","source":{"file":"monmove.c","function":"m_move -> worm.c worm_nomove","branch":"cnt1 candidate skipped by m_avoid_kicked_loc"},"state":"Supported pass-walls intrinsic permits constructing three vertical floor cells enclosed by twelve wall wishes; sleeping peaceful worm spawns at one endpoint, hero later moves to other and kicks middle cell","expectedCObservation":"Nonzero candidate count avoids early MMOVE_NOMOVES; sole kicked exit is skipped and worm_nomove spends d(2,2)","sourceCorrection":"monmove.c1926-1931 returns before tail cleanup at cnt0. m_avoid_kicked_loc1297-1306 can skip a candidate after enumeration; worm_nomove288-296 then shrinks tail and lowers HP."}. No JavaScript comparison of the earlier crowded worm route has run. Source correction action5: gain dexterity is not a NetHack ring. Two blessed gain ability potions raise initial Dexterity15 above kick_dumb injury threshold; Stealth keeps the sleeping worm asleep until kick wake_nearby. Sole middle open-door candidate is adjacent to both hero and worm; repeated kicks maintain context.kickedloc while speed3 worm receives movement turns. Cheap variation uses rest instead of kicks, allowing the peaceful worm to use the middle exit.
